# Paramahansa Yogananda’s Advice About World Predictions

### Brother Chidananda • Self-Realization Fellowship

Loving greetings. In these times of global change, there are many alarming predictions about the future of the world. Brother Chidananda shares our beloved Guru’s comforting and practical advice: do not live in fear of the future, but anchor your soul in the eternal protection of God.

### Rising Above World Dualities

This world will always have cycles of light and darkness. If we rely solely on outward material conditions for our security, we will always be restless. But if we establish our connection with the Divine in meditation, we can walk through any crisis with dynamic strength.

### The Best Protective Shield

Yogananda taught that the best protective shield is a highly magnetised body and mind, charged with the power of regular sadhana and selfless service. No earthly catastrophe can touch the immortal soul.

### Practical Guidelines for Daily Life

* **Banish Media Clutter:** Avoid consuming excessive negative news and predictions that generate anxiety.
* **Affirm Protection:** Repeat: *"I am secure in Thy presence, Lord. Thy protective light surrounds me."*
* **Sadhana First:** Commit to your daily meditation to remain balanced and intuitive.
* **Support Others:** Be a beacon of strength and comfort to your family and friends, radiating courage.

May you walk in His light. Jai Guru!
rawText: Master advised us not to live in fear of catastrophic predictions. World cycles have ups and downs, but those who are anchored in daily meditation remain forever protected...
